source: Baltimore Magazine Best Restaurants 2026 and Visit Baltimore (baltimore.org) guides; coordinates from baltimore.org listing/event Google Maps links, lexingtonmarket.com map link, and Wikipedia coordinates for the National Aquarium, Fort McHenry and AVAM.

spots.name: Gertrude's
spots.area: Baltimore Museum of Art, Charles Village

spots.name: B&O Railroad Museum
spots.blurb: Historic roundhouse full of locomotives and train cars, with short train rides
spots.blurbEs: Histórica rotonda ferroviaria llena de locomotoras y vagones, con paseos cortos en tren

spots.name: The Walters Art Museum
spots.blurb: Free art museum with everything from ancient Egyptian objects to medieval armor and 19th-century paintings
spots.blurbEs: Museo de arte gratuito con piezas desde el antiguo Egipto hasta armaduras medievales y pinturas del siglo XIX

spots.name: The Baltimore Museum of Art
spots.blurb: Free art museum known for its Matisse collection and sculpture gardens
spots.blurbEs: Museo de arte gratuito conocido por su colección de Matisse y sus jardines de esculturas

spots.name: National Aquarium
spots.blurb: Big harbor-front aquarium with sharks, dolphins, a rooftop rainforest and an Australia gallery
spots.blurbEs: Gran acuario frente al puerto con tiburones, delfines, una selva tropical en la azotea y una galería de Australia

spots.name: Fort McHenry National Monument and Historic Shrine
spots.blurb: The star-shaped fort whose defense in 1814 inspired the national anthem, with waterfront grounds to walk
spots.blurbEs: El fuerte en forma de estrella cuya defensa en 1814 inspiró el himno nacional, con terrenos junto al agua para pasear

spots.name: American Visionary Art Museum
spots.blurb: Colorful museum of self-taught 'outsider' artists, with a mirrored exterior and a giant whirligig
spots.blurbEs: Colorido museo de artistas autodidactas, con una fachada de espejos y un gran molinete
